instruction:
Create a League of Legends tournament broadcast overlay with a distinctive dark charcoal, teal and burnt-orange identity.
Keep the scoreboard centered at the top, roughly half the screen width. Give the left team a visible dark teal gradient and the right team a burnt-orange gradient, both fading toward a neutral dark center. Make the scores prominent and keep team names, gold, objectives and the clock easy to read.
Place two mirrored five-player tables together at the bottom. Put items toward the outside and names and statistics toward the middle. Champion portraits should be slightly larger than individual item icons.
Use condensed player names, stronger CS numbers and quieter KDA. Carry the team colours into restrained portrait frames and subtle row accents. Keep the main surfaces dark, with fine separators and enough spacing for every statistic to remain readable. Leave the gameplay and minimap clear.
